52.en: Pondering thus, the highsouled Hanuman remained concealed on the tree loaded with flowers and leaves and waited, looking eagerly for the wife of the lord of the people. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
52.hi: इस देवो का मन श्रीरामचन्द्रजी में है ग्रौर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का भन इसमे है, इसलिए ये सीता देवी और वे धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी, प्रब तक जी रहे हैं । नहीं तो (ये दोनों) एक क्षण भी नहीं जी सकते थे

53.hi: इनके विरह में श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का जीते रहना बड़ा ही दुष्कर कार्ये है । आश्चर्य है, सीताजी के विरह-जन्य-शोक से पीड़ित ! ऐकर भी, श्री रामचन्द्रजी अब तक जीवित हैं, नहों तो इतको विरह-जन्प-शोक से उनका (श्रीराम- चन्द्रजी का) नष्ट हो जाना कोई श्राइचय की बात न थी

54.hi: र कर | मेरी समझ में तो महाबाहु श्रीरामचन्द्रजी यह वडा ही दुष्कर कार्य कर | फील: १६६ रहे हूँ कि, सीता जेसी श्रनुरागवती पत्नी के बिना वे मुहुर्त भर भी जीवित रह रहे हैं

1.sa: स वीक्षमाणः तत्रस्थो मार्गमाणः च मैथिलीम् ।अवेक्षमाणः च महीम् सर्वाम् ताम् अन्ववैक्षत ॥५-१५-१॥
1.en: Hanuman looked out from the simsupa tree all around for Mythili scanning the ground below.

2.sa: सन्तान कलताभिः च पादपैर् उपशोभिताम् ।दिव्य गन्ध रस उपेताम् सर्वतः समलम्कृताम् ॥५-१५-२॥
2.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

3.sa: ताम् स नन्दन सम्काशाम् मृग पक्षिभिर् आवृताम् ।हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्बाधाम् कोकिल आकुल निह्स्वनाम् ॥५-१५-३॥
3.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.
3.hi: गुरुओं द्वारा सुशिक्षित श्रोलक्ष्मण के ज्येष्ठश्राता श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की पत्नी सीता, जब ऐसे कष्ट भोग रही हँ, तब दूसरों का कहना ही क्या है? हा ! काल के प्रभाव को उल्लंघन करना ( अथवा काल के प्रभाव से बचना.) सर्वथा हुस्साच्य है

4.sa: कान्चन उत्पल पद्माभिः वापीभिः उपशोभिताम् ।बह्व आसन कुथा उपेताम् बहु भूमि गृह आयुताम् ॥५-१५-४॥
4.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.
4.hi: सीताजी, बद्धिमान श्रीरामचन्द्रजी श्रौर लक्ष्षणजी की प्रयत्नशीसता या पराक्रम को भली भांति जानती है। तभी तो वर्षाकालीन गज्जा की तरह, अन्य नदियों का जल झाने पर भी यह क्षोभ को प्राप्त नहीं हो रही हूँ

5.sa: सर्व ऋतु कुसुमैः रम्यैः फलवद्भिः च पादपैः ।पुष्पितानाम् अशोकानाम् श्रिया सूर्य उदय प्रभाम् ॥५-१५-५॥
5.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.
5.hi: श्री रामचंद्रजी ने इन्हीं के लिए युद्ध में भयंकर पराक्रमी विराध को उसी प्रकार मारा था; जिस प्रकार इन्द्र ने शंबरासुर को

6.sa: प्रदीप्ताम् इव तत्रस्थो मारुतिः समुदैक्षत ।निष्पत्र शाखाम् विहगैः क्रियमाणाम् इव असकृत् ॥५-१५-६॥
6.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

7.sa: विनिष्पतद्भिः शतशः चित्रैः पुष्प अवतम्सकैः ।आमूल पुष्प निचितैर् अशोकैः शोक नाशनैः ॥५-१५-७॥
7.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.
7.hi: श्रस्या हेतोविशालाक्ष्या हतो वाली महाबलः । रावणप्रतिमो वीये कबन्धशच निपातितः

8.sa: पुष्प भार अतिभारैः च स्पृशद्भिर् इव मेदिनीम् ।कर्णिकारैः कुसुमितैः किम्शुकैः च सुपुष्पितैः ॥५-१५-८॥
8.en: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

9.sa: स देशः प्रभया तेषाम् प्रदीप्त इव सर्वतः ।पुम्नागाः सप्त पर्णाः च चम्पक उद्दालकाः तथा ॥५-१५-९॥
9.en: The grove shone bright as if it were inflamed fire with beautiful trees like purnaga, saptaparna, champak and uddalaka in full bloom.

10.sa: विवृद्ध मूला बहवः शोभन्ते स्म सुपुष्पिताः ।शात कुम्भ निभाः केचित् केचिद् अग्नि शिख उपमाः ॥५-१५-१०॥
10.en: There were thousands of ashoka trees some of which shone like gold, others like the flames of fire and some dark as collyrium.
10.hi: इन्हीं के लिए श्रीरामचंद्रजी ने अग्निशिखा की तरह चमचमाते ब्राणों' से जनस्थान-निवासी भयंकर कर्म करने वाले चौदह हजार राक्षसों को माराः था ।।॥। खरश्च निहतः संख्ये त्रिशिराश्च निपातितः । दूषणश्च महातेजा रामेण विदितात्मना

11.sa: नील अन्जन निभाः केचित् तत्र अशोकाः सहस्रशः ।नन्दनम् विविध उद्यानम् चित्रम् चैत्ररथम् यथा ॥५-१५-११॥
11.en: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷
11.hi: इन्हीं के पीछे दुर्लभ वानरों का राज्य, जिसका पालन वालि करता था, लोकमान्य सुग्रीव को मिला

12.sa: अतिवृत्तम् इव अचिन्त्यम् दिव्यम् रम्यम् श्रिया वृतम् ।द्वितीयम् इव च आकाशम् पुष्प ज्योतिर् गण आयुतम् ॥५-१५-१२॥
12.en: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷

13.sa: पुष्प रत्न शतैः चित्रम् पन्चमम् सागरम् यथा ।सर्व ऋतु पुष्पैर् निचितम् पादपैर् मधु गन्धिभिः  ॥५-१५-१३॥
13.en: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷
13.hi: मेरी समझ में तो यदि श्रीरामचंद्रजी इस देवी के लिए, केवल यहः पृथ्वी ही नहीं, बल्कि समस्त लोकों को भी उलट दे तो भी उनका ऐसा करना: उचित ही होगा

14.sa: नाना निनादैः उद्यानम् रम्यम् मृग गणैर् द्विजैः ।अनेक गन्ध प्रवहम् पुण्य गन्धम् मनो रमम् ॥५-१५-१४॥
14.en: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷

15.sa: शैल इन्द्रम् इव गन्ध आढ्यम् द्वितीयम् गन्ध मादनम् ।अशोक वनिकायाम् तु तस्याम् वानर पुम्गवः ॥५-१५-१५॥
15.en: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
15.hi: क्योंकि धर्मात्मा महात्मा जनक की यह सुता सीता, पातिब्रत ष्म का निर्वाह करने में पूणं रूप से दृढ़ हैं

16.sa: स ददर्श अविदूरस्थम् चैत्य प्रासादम् ऊर्जितम् ।मध्ये स्तम्भ सहस्रेण स्थितम् कैलास पाण्डुरम् ॥५-१५-१६॥
16.en: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
16.hi: पद्मरेण्‌ की तरह खेती की घूल से धूसरित, हल की नोंक से जुते हुए खेत से यहद पृथिवी को फोड़ कर निकली थी

17.sa: प्रवाल कृत सोपानम् तप्त कान्चन वेदिकम् ।मुष्णन्तम् इव चक्षूम्षि द्योतमानम् इव श्रिया ॥५-१५-१७॥
17.en: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
17.hi: और बड़े पराक्रमी श्रेष्ठस्वभाव वाले भ्रौर युद्ध में कभी पीठ न दिखाने बाले महाराज दशरथ की महायशस्विनी जेठी पुत्रबधू है

18.sa: विमलम् प्राम्शु भावत्वाद् उल्लिखन्तम् इव अम्बरम् ।ततो मलिन सम्वीताम् राक्षसीभिः समावृताम्  ॥५-१५-१८॥
18.en: Then he beheld a lady surrounded by female demons. Clad in soiled clothes she looked dejected, emaciated through fasting and was sighing repeatedly. She appeared thin and pale like the crescent Moon at the beginning of the bright fortnight.
18.hi: प्रोर धर्मात्मा, कृतज्ञ तथा प्रसिद्ध पुरुष श्रौरामचन्द्रजी की यह प्यारी पत्नी है । सो इस समय यह ब्रेचारी, राक्षसियों के वश में ग्रा पड़ी हें

19.sa: उपवास कृशाम् दीनाम् निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ।ददर्श शुक्ल पक्ष आदौ चन्द्र रेखाम् इव अमलाम् ॥५-१५-१९॥
19.en: Then he beheld a lady surrounded by female demons. Clad in soiled clothes she looked dejected, emaciated through fasting and was sighing repeatedly. She appeared thin and pale like the crescent Moon at the beginning of the bright fortnight.

20.sa: मन्द प्रख्यायमानेन रूपेण रुचिर प्रभाम् ।पिनद्धाम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-२०॥
20.en: Her form was faintly recognisable. She had a lovely radiance on account of her beautiful form. She looked like the tip of burning fire engulfed in a cloud of smoke.

21.sa: पीतेन एकेन सम्वीताम् क्लिष्टेन उत्तम वाससा ।सपन्काम् अनलम्काराम् विपद्माम् इव पद्मिनीम् ॥५-१५-२१॥
21.en: She was wearing an excellent single yellow cloth which was soiled. Unadorned, she looked like a muddy lotuspond bereft of lotuses.

22.sa: व्रीडिताम् दुह्ख सम्तप्ताम् परिम्लानाम् तपस्विनीम् ।ग्रहेण अन्गारकेण एव पीडिताम् इव रोहिणीम् ॥५-१५-२२॥
22.en: She was bashful, tormented with agony, dejected with a withered look. She appeared like the star Rohini oppressed by planet Mars.

23.sa: अश्रु पूर्ण मुखीम् दीनाम् कृशाम् अननशेन च ।शोक ध्यान पराम् दीनाम् नित्यम् दुह्ख परायणाम् ॥५-१५-२३॥
23.en: Her face was filled with tears. She looked dejected and emaciated due to fasting. Always plunged in grief, she looked like one meditating in tears.

24.sa: प्रियम् जनम् अपश्यन्तीम् पश्यन्तीम् राक्षसी गणम् ।स्व गणेन मृगीम् हीनाम् श्व गण अभिवृताम् इव ॥५-१५-२४॥
24.en: Unable to see her dear kith and kin, she sat guarded by ogresses. She appeared like a doe separated from the herd and encircled by a pack of hounds.

25.sa: नील नाग आभया वेण्या जघनम् गतया एकया ।नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥५-१५-२५॥
25.en: She (from behind) appeared like the earth covered with a range of trees at the end of rainy season with her single long black braid touching her hips looking like a black serpent. She who deserved to be happy and had not experienced worries was burning in grief. (एकवेणी is a trait of a प्रोषितभर्तृका Sita who was forced to stay in Lanka was a प्रोषितभर्तृका नायिका.)

26.sa: सुख अर्हाम् दुह्ख सम्तप्ताम् व्यसनानाम् अकोदिवाम् ।ताम् समीक्ष्य विशाल अक्षीम् अधिकम् मलिनाम् कृशाम् ॥५-१५-२६॥
26.en: After seeing the largeeyed lady worn out and dressed in soiled clothes, Hanuman started deliberating in himself and guessed it was Sita for strong reasons.

27.sa: तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादिभिः ।ह्रियमाणा तदा तेन रक्षसा काम रूपिणा ॥५-१५-२७॥
27.en: Beholding the form of the largeeyed lady, Hanuman guessed, 'This is similar to the form seen while the demon was kidnapping her'.

28.sa: यथा रूपा हि दृष्टा वै तथा रूपा इयम् अन्गना ।पूर्ण चन्द्र आननाम् सुभ्रूम् चारु वृत्त पयो धराम् ॥५-१५-२८॥
28.en: Her face resembled the fullmoon which dispelled the encircling gloom by its radiance. She had a slender waist, beautiful round breasts, shapely eyebrows, red lips, dark hair, and eyes like lotus petals with attractive limbs. She was comparable to Rati, consort of Cupid.

29.sa: कुर्वन्तीम् प्रभया देवीम् सर्वा वितिमिरा दिशः ।ताम् नील केशीम् बिम्ब ओष्ठीम् सुमध्याम् सुप्रतिष्ठिताम् ॥५-१५-२९॥
29.en: Her face resembled the fullmoon which dispelled the encircling gloom by its radiance. She had a slender waist, beautiful round breasts, shapely eyebrows, red lips, dark hair, and eyes like lotus petals with attractive limbs. She was comparable to Rati, consort of Cupid.

30.sa: सीताम् पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मन्मथस्य रतिम् यथा ।इष्टाम् सर्वस्य जगतः पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव ॥५-१५-३०॥
30.en: Just as the radiance of the full moon is cherished by all, this lady was liked by every one in this world. With her lovely figure she was seated on the ground like an austere ascetic.

31.sa: भूमौ सुतनुम् आसीनाम् नियताम् इव तापसीम् ।निःश्वास बहुलाम् भीरुम् भुजग इन्द्र वधूम् इव ॥५-१५-३१॥
31.en: The timid lady was hissing (sighing) like the consort of the serpent king, who being caught in a widespread cobweb of grief was looking gloomy.

32.sa: शोक जालेन महता विततेन न राजतीम् ।सम्सक्ताम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-३२॥
32.en: She was like the flames of fire obscured by smoke. She appeared like the text of Smriti of doubtful meaning, a treasure that has been thrown away

33.sa: ताम् स्मृतीम् इव सम्दिघ्दाम् ऋद्धिम् निपतिताम् इव ।विहताम् इव च श्रद्धाम् आशाम् प्रतिहताम् इव ॥५-१५-३३॥
33.en: She was like faith shattered, hope frustrated, desires blocked by obstacles, success vitiated, fame marred and intellect blurred.

34.sa: स उपसर्गाम् यथा सिद्धिम् बुद्धिम् सकलुषाम् इव ।अभूतेन अपवादेन कीर्तिम् निपतिताम् इव ॥५-१५-३४॥
34.en: She appeared like fame besmirched by false allegation. She was pained by the obstruction to meet Rama and emaciated by abduction.

35.sa: राम उपरोध व्यथिताम् रक्षो हरण कर्शिताम् ।अबलाम् मृग शाव अक्षीम् वीक्षमाणाम् ततः ततः ॥५-१५-३५॥
35.en: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.

36.sa: बाष्प अम्बु प्रतिपूर्णेन कृष्ण वक्त्र अक्षि पक्ष्मणा ।वदनेन अप्रसन्नेन निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ॥५-१५-३६॥
36.en: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.

37.sa: मल पन्क धराम् दीनाम् मण्डन अर्हाम् अमण्डिताम् ।प्रभाम् नक्षत्र राजस्य काल मेघैः इव आवृताम् ॥५-१५-३७॥
37.en: Covered with dirt and mud and shorn of adornments even though she deserved them, she looked wretched like the radiance of the Moon muffled by dark clouds.

38.sa: तस्य सम्दिदिहे बुद्धिः मुहुः सीताम् निरीक्ष्य तु ।आम्नायानाम् अयोगेन विद्याम् प्रशिथिलाम् इव ॥५-१५-३८॥
38.en: Hanuman did recognise Sita after looking at her carefully again and again even as one is able to make out knowledge of shastriclore forgotten with lapse of time and lack of practice.

39.sa: दुह्खेन बुबुधे सीताम् हनुमान् अनलम्कृताम् ।सम्स्कारेण यथा हीनाम् वाचम् अर्थ अन्तरम् गताम् ॥५-१५-३९॥
39.en: Just as an unclear expression which has undergone certain changes in meaning due to lack of usage over a long period is understood by virtue of previous practice so also Hanuman had difficulty in recognising Sita who was devoid of any decoration.

40.sa: ताम् समीक्ष्य विशाल अक्षीम् राज पुत्रीम् अनिन्दिताम् ।तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादयन् ॥५-१५-४०॥
40.en: After close observation of different signs and deliberation with reasons he came to the conclusion that the largeeyed lady is the same blameless princess Sita.

41.sa: वैदेह्या यानि च अन्गेषु तदा रामो अन्वकीर्तयत् ।तानि आभरण जालानि गात्र शोभीनि अलक्षयत् ॥५-१५-४१॥
41.en: Hanuman observed the ornaments worn by Vaidehi adding grace to her limbs which Rama had described.They were wellcrafted earrings and wellfit Savdamshtras. He noticed wonderful, variegated ornaments of corals and gems as well as those worn on hands. They were blackened for long wear and Sita had marks of wearing them on her body. (Note: This is a pair ornaments shaped like dog's teeth. It is not known on which part of the body they were worn).

42.sa: सुकृतौ कर्ण वेष्टौ च श्व दम्ष्ट्रौ च सुसम्स्थितौ ।मणि विद्रुम चित्राणि हस्तेष्व् आभरणानि च ॥५-१५-४२॥
42.en: Hanuman observed the ornaments worn by Vaidehi adding grace to her limbs which Rama had described.They were wellcrafted earrings and wellfit Savdamshtras. He noticed wonderful, variegated ornaments of corals and gems as well as those worn on hands. They were blackened for long wear and Sita had marks of wearing them on her body. (Note: This is a pair ornaments shaped like dog's teeth. It is not known on which part of the body they were worn).

43.sa: श्यामानि चिर युक्तत्वात् तथा सम्स्थानवन्ति च ।तानि एव एतानि मन्ये अहम् यानि रामो अन्वकीर्तयत् ॥५-१५-४३॥
43.en: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."

44.sa: तत्र यानि अवहीनानि तानि अहम् न उपलक्षये ।यानि अस्या न अवहीनानि तानि इमानि न सम्शयः ॥५-१५-४४॥
44.en: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."

45.sa: पीतम् कनक पट्ट आभम् स्रस्तम् तद् वसनम् शुभम् ।उत्तरीयम् नग आसक्तम् तदा दृष्टम् प्लवम् गमैः ॥५-१५-४५॥
45.en: "The shining yellow upper garment like a golden cloth was torn. Flung down, it stuck to a tree which the monkeys noticed.

46.sa: भूषणानि च मुख्यानि दृष्टानि धरणी तले ।अनया एव अपविद्धानि स्वनवन्ति महान्ति च ॥५-१५-४६॥
46.en: "The jingling, choice ornaments were thrown down on the ground.

47.sa: इदम् चिर गृहीतत्वाद् वसनम् क्लिष्टवत्तरम् ।तथा हि नूनम् तद् वर्णम् तथा श्रीमद् यथा इतरत् ॥५-१५-४७॥
47.en: "This cloth worn long is crumpled. Even then it has retained its shine and looks fresh.

48.sa: इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।प्रनष्टा अपि सती यस्य मनसो न प्रणश्यति ॥५-१५-४८॥
48.en: "This lady of golden complexion is Rama's beloved queen who does not disappear from his mind, although away.

49.sa: इयम् सा यत् कृते रामः चतुर्भिः परितप्यते ।कारुण्येन आनृशम्स्येन शोकेन मदनेन च ॥५-१५-४९॥
49.en: "She is that same lady for whom Rama has been passing through compassion, benevolence, grief and passion. He is compassionate considering her a woman, kind and benevolent since she is his dependent, stricken with grief for losing a wife and passionate since she is his beloved.

50.sa: स्त्री प्रनष्टा इति कारुण्याद् आश्रिता इति आनृशम्स्यतः ।पत्नी नष्टा इति शोकेन प्रियेति मदनेन च ॥५-१५-५०॥
50.en: "She is that same lady for whom Rama has been passing through compassion, benevolence, grief and passion. He is compassionate considering her a woman, kind and benevolent since she is his dependent, stricken with grief for losing a wife and passionate since she is his beloved.

51.sa: अस्या देव्या यथा रूपम् अन्ग प्रत्यन्ग सौष्ठवम् ।रामस्य च यथा रूपम् तस्य इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१५-५१॥
51.en: "This blackeyed Sita and her divine, charming body with perfect limbs are a match for Rama's figure.

52.sa: अस्या देव्या मनः तस्मिमः तस्य च अस्याम् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।तेन इयम् स च धर्म आत्मा मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवति ॥५-१५-५२॥
52.en: "The divine queen's mind is firmly fixed on Rama and his mind, fixed on her. For this reason she and the righteous self (Rama) are able to survive till this moment.

53.sa: दुष्करम् कुरुते रामो इमाम् मत्त काशिनीम् ।सीताम् विना महा बाहुः मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवति ॥५-१५-५३॥
53.en: "Lord Rama had accomplished a difficult task in sustaining the body this way without allowing it to sink and perish during separation from her.

54.sa: एवम् सीताम् तदा दृष्ट्वा हृष्टः पवन सम्भवः ।जगाम मनसा रामम् प्रशशम्स च तम् प्रभुम् ॥५-१५-५४॥
54.en: "Rama, the strongarmed hero has accomplished a difficult task by surviving even for a moment without this Sita who has intoxicating lustre".

1.sa: प्रशस्य तु प्रशस्तव्याम् सीताम् ताम् हरि पुम्गवः ।गुण अभिरामम् रामम् च पुनः चिन्ता परो अभवत् ॥५-१६-१॥
1.en: Hanuman, the bull among monkeys, admired the laudable Sita and the virtuous Rama and once again began to lament.

2.sa: स मुहूर्तम् इव ध्यात्वा बाष्प पर्याकुलेक्षणः ।सीताम् आश्रित्य तेजस्वी हनुमान् विललाप ह ॥५-१६-२॥
2.en: Sagacious Hanuman, eyes dimmed with tears, thought for a short while on the plight of Sita and lamented
2.hi: आर फल-फूल खा कर सन्तुष्ट हो, प्रपने पति को सेवा करती हुई ठएरएक्रीपम्तढहएल्ड)मिफे पराउन होउउही ५hntRAhleGangotr Initiative । सेयं कनकवर्णाङ्गा नित्यं सुस्मितभाषिणी । सहते यातनामेतामनर्धानामभागिनी

3.sa: मान्या गुरु विनीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य गुरु प्रिया ।यदि सीता अपि दुह्ख आर्ता कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥५-१६-३॥
3.en: "If Sita, who is worshipped by righteous Lakshmana and loved by Rama is tortured like this, it shows it is difficult to trangress the force of time.

4.sa: रामस्य व्यवसायज्ञा लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः ।न अत्यर्थम् क्षुभ्यते देवी गन्गा इव जलद आगमे ॥५-१६-४॥
4.en: "Just as river Ganga is not agitated by the rainbearing clouds, this Sita is not perturbed as she is aware of the prowess of Rama and might of Lakshmana.

5.sa: तुल्य शील वयो वृत्ताम् तुल्य अभिजन लक्षणाम् ।राघवो अर्हति वैदेहीम् तम् च इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१६-५॥
5.en: "Sri Rama matches Vaidehi perfectly in character, age, behaviour, birth and auspicious signs. She is aware that he is the right person for her. Rama deserves Vaidehi and this blackeyed lady deserves him."

6.sa: ताम् दृष्ट्वा नव हेम आभाम् लोक कान्ताम् इव श्रियम् ।जगाम मनसा रामम् वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥५-१६-६॥
6.en: On seeing her glowing like fresh gold resembling goddess Lakshmi who is dear to the entire world, and thinking of Rama, Hanuman said:

7.sa: अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्या हतो वाली महा बलः ।रावण प्रतिमो वीर्ये कबन्धः च निपातितः ॥५-१६-७॥
7.en: "It was for the sake of this largeeyed Sita that the powerful Vali and the heroic Kabandha who was equal to Ravana in heroism were killed.

8.sa: विराधः च हतः सम्ख्ये राक्षसो भीम विक्रमः ।वने रामेण विक्रम्य महा इन्द्रेण इव शम्बरः ॥५-१६-८॥
8.en: "Rama killed Viradha of fearsome valour in the forest like Sambara by Indra.

9.sa: चतुर् दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् ।निहतानि जन स्थाने शरैर् अग्नि शिख उपमैः ॥५-१६-९॥
9.en: Fourteen thousand demons of terrible deeds were slain at Janasthana by arrows resembling tongues of fire.

10.sa: करः च निहतः सम्ख्ये त्रिशिराः च निपातितः ।दूषणः च महा तेजा रामेण विदित आत्मना ॥५-१६-१०॥
10.en: "Ogres like Khara and Trisira and the powerful Dooshana were kileed in battle by Rama endowed with selfknowledge.

11.sa: ऐश्वर्यम् वानराणाम् च दुर्लभम् वालि पालितम् ।अस्या निमित्ते सुग्रीवः प्राप्तवान् लोक सत्कृतम् ॥५-१६-११॥
11.en: On her account Sugriva obtained the coveted kingdom ruled by Vali which was a difficult proposition, and retained supremacy in the world.

12.sa: सागरः च मया क्रान्तः श्रीमान् नद नदी पतिः ।अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्याः पुरी च इयम् निरीक्षिता ॥५-१६-१२॥
12.en: "On account of the largeeyed Sita I ventured to cross the lord of rivers, the sea, and came to this city.

13.sa: यदि रामः समुद्रान्ताम् मेदिनीम् परिवर्तयेत् ।अस्याः कृते जगत् च अपि युक्तम् इति एव मे मतिः ॥५-१६-१३॥
13.en: "Even if Rama turns this land stretching to the ocean upside down or even the entire world on account of her, it is justifiable, according to me.

14.sa: राज्यम् वा त्रिषु लोकेषु सीता वा जनक आत्मजा ।त्रैलोक्य राज्यम् सकलम् सीताया न आप्नुयात् कलाम् ॥५-१६-१४॥
14.en: "The sovereignty over the three worlds will weigh less than one sixteenth part of Janaka's daughter, Sita.

15.sa: इयम् सा धर्म शीलस्य जनकस्य महात्मनः ।सुता मैथिलराजस्य सीता भर्तृदृढ व्रता ॥५-१६-१५॥
15.en: She had risen from the land when tilled by the plough and was covered with auspicious paddy dust resembling the pollen grains of lotuses, this daughter of Janaka, the great righteous ruler of Mithila, This lady with unswerving devotion to her husband.

16.sa: उत्थिता मेदिनीम् भित्त्वा क्षेत्रे हल मुख क्षते ।पद्म रेणु निभैः कीर्णा शुभैः केदार पाम्सुभिः ॥५-१६-१६॥
16.en: She had risen from the land when tilled by the plough and was covered with auspicious paddy dust resembling the pollen grains of lotuses, this daughter of Janaka, the great righteous ruler of Mithila, This lady with unswerving devotion to her husband.

17.sa: विक्रान्तस्य आर्य शीलस्य सम्युगेषु अनिवर्तिनः ।स्नुषा दशरथस्य एषा ज्येष्ठा राज्ञो यशस्विनी ॥५-१६-१७॥
17.en: "This celebrated lady is the eldest daughterinlaw of the noble, valiant king Dasaratha who never returned from the battleground without being victorious.

18.sa: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य रामस्य विदित आत्मनः ।इयम् सा दयिता भार्या राक्षसी वशम् आगता ॥५-१६-१८॥
18.en: "She is the loving wife of the righteous, grateful, wise and selfrealised Rama. She has fallen into the hands of these shedemons.

19.sa: सर्वान् भोगान् परित्यज्य भर्तृ स्नेह बलात् कृता ।अचिन्तयित्वा दुह्खानि प्रविष्टा निर्जनम् वनम् ॥५-१६-१९॥
19.en: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way

20.sa: सम्तुष्टा फल मूलेन भर्तृ शुश्रूषणा परा ।या पराम् भजते प्रीतिम् वने अपि भवने यथा ॥५-१६-२०॥
20.en: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way

21.sa: सा इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी नित्यम् सुस्मित भाषिणी ।सहते यातनाम् एताम् अनर्थानाम् अभागिनी ॥५-१६-२१॥
21.en: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way
21.hi: जिसने कभी कोई विपत्ति नहीं झेली, जो सदा हसमुख बनी रहती थी, वही यह सुवणं सदृश वणं वाली सीता, कष्टों रौर भ्रनर्थो को भोग रहीं! है

22.sa: इमाम् तु शील सम्पन्नाम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चति राघवः ।रावणेन प्रमथिताम् प्रपाम् इव पिपासितः ॥५-१६-२२॥
22.en: "Rama deserves to see her.Just as a thirsty man longs for the source of water, Rama pines for this highly virtuous lady who is tormented by Ravana.
22.hi: रावण द्वारा सताई हुई इस सुशीला जानकी को देखने के लिए श्री रामचन्द्रजी उसी तरह उत्सुक हैँ जिस तरह पौशाला देखने को प्यासाः उत्सुक हुआ करता है

23.sa: अस्या नूनम् पुनर् लाभाद् राघवः प्रीतिम् एष्यति ।राजा राज्य परिभ्रष्टः पुनः प्राप्य इव मेदिनीम् ॥५-१६-२३॥
23.en: "Just as a king who had lost his kingdom feels happy on regaining it, surely Raghava will feel exhilarated when he gets her back.
23.hi: निश्चय ही इसको पुनः पाकर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी. वैसे ही प्रसन्न होंगे; जेसे खोये हुए राज्य को प्राप्त कर राजा प्रसन्न होता है

24.sa: काम भोगैः परित्यक्ता हीना बन्धु जनेन च ।धारयति आत्मनो देहम् तत् समागम कान्क्षिणी ॥५-१६-२४॥
24.en: Deprived of all sensual pleasures, and separated from her relatives, she is surviving with the hope of meeting them.
24.hi: माला चन्दनादि सुख-भोगों से वञ्चित श्रौर बन्बुवान्धवों से रहित यह जानकी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी से मिलने की श्राया ही से प्राण धारण किए हुए है

25.sa: न एषा पश्यति राक्षस्यो न इमान् पुष्प फल द्रुमान् ।एकस्थ हृदया नूनम् रामम् एव अनुपश्यति ॥५-१६-२५॥
25.en: She is looking at neither the shedemons nor these trees full of flowers and fruits. She is surely thinking of Rama with a singleminded attention.
25.hi: न तो ये राक्षसियों को श्रौर न फले-फूले इन वृक्षों की श्रोर देखती है । यह तो एकाग्र मन से केवल श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ध्यान ही में मग्न, है

26.sa: भर्ता नाम परम् नार्या भूषणम् भूषणाद् अपि ।एषा हि रहिता तेन शोभन अर्हा न शोभते ॥५-१६-२६॥
26.en: "Indeed, the husband is the greatest ornament for a married woman. Hence though deserving adornment she does not like it, bereft of her husband who is her only ornament.
26.hi: क्योंकि स्त्रियों के लिए उनका पति ही भूषण है, बल्कि भूषण से भी बढ़ कर ही है । प्रतः यह पतिवियोग के कारण, शोभा योग्य होने पर भी, शोभायमान नहीं हो रही है

27.sa: दुष्करम् कुरुते रामो हीनो यद् अनया प्रभुः ।धारयति आत्मनो देहम् न दुह्खेन अवसीदति ॥५-१६-२७॥
27.en: "Lord Rama indeed performs a difficult task in surviving without her. That he is not feeling despondent is a wonder.
27.hi: इसके पति श्रीरामचन्द्रजी इसके वियोग में भी जीते हें; सो सचमुच वे म्यह बड़ा दुष्कर कार्य कर रहे हँ

28.sa: इमाम् असित केश अन्ताम् शत पत्र निभ ईक्षणाम् ।सुख अर्हाम् दुःखिताम् ज्~आत्वा मम अपि व्यथितम् मनः ॥५-१६-२८॥
28.en: Sita who is endowed with beautiful dark hair and eyes like a hundredpetalled lotus, who deserves to be happy is in sorrow. I grieve to see her in this state.
28.hi: काले केशवाली, कमलनयनी श्रौर सुख भोगने योग्य इस जानकी को दुःखी देख, मेरा भी कलेजा मारे दु:ख के फटा जाता है

29.sa: क्षिति क्षमा पुष्कर सम्निभ अक्षी ।या रक्षिता राघव लक्ष्मणाभ्याम् ।सा राक्षसीभिर् विकृत ईक्षणाभिः ।सम्रक्ष्यते सम्प्रति वृक्ष मूले ॥५-१६-२९॥
29.en: She who has beautiful eyes like lotus petals, was protected by the arms of both Rama and Lakshmna, who is tolerant like the earth and is guarded by the female demons of hideous appearance under a tree.

30.sa: हिम हत नलिनी इव नष्ट शोभा ।व्यसन परम्परया निपीड्यमाना ।सह चर रहिता इव चक्र वाकी ।जनक सुता कृपणाम् दशाम् प्रपन्ना ॥५-१६-३०॥
30.en: "Deprived of her charm, she resembles a lotuscreeper blasted by frost. This daughter of Janaka has reached a pitiable condition afflicted by series of calamities. She resembles a famale Chakravaka separated from her mate.
30.hi: “पाठान्तरे--“एषा तु रहिता ।” । : सग: ७4 सीता, पाले की मारी कमलिनी की तरह, दुःखों से उत्पीडित हो तथा बकवा से रहित चकवी की तरह, शोच्यं दशा को प्राप्त हुई है

31.sa: अस्या हि पुष्प अवनत अग्र शाखाः ।शोकम् दृढम् वै जनयति अशोकाः ।हिम व्यपायेन च शीतरश्मिः ।रभ्युत्थितो न एक सहस्र रश्मिः ॥५-१६-३१॥
31.en: "The top branches of Ashoka trees bent down with blossoms and the Moon rising with thousands of cool rays at the end of winter (when spring sets in) beholding which she should be delighted intensfy her sorrow."
31.hi: फलों के भार से झुकी हुई भ्रशोक-वृक्ष की ये डालियाँ. और वसन्तः कालीन यह निर्मल और सूर्यं की ग्रपेक्षा मन्द किरणों वाला यह चन्द्रमा, इस देवी के शोक को प्रौर मी प्रधिक बढ़ा रहे हे

32.sa: इति एवम् अर्थम् कपिर् अन्ववेक्ष्य ।सीता इयम् इति एव निविष्ट बुद्धिः ।सम्श्रित्य तस्मिन् निषसाद वृक्षे ।बली हरीणाम् ऋषभः तरस्वी ॥५-१६-३२॥
32.en: Hanuman, the swiftfooted bull among monkeys, on his part waiting on the Simsupa tree thus reflecting concluded in his mind that she was Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षोडशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the sixteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
32.hi: । महाबीर कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमान -इस प्रकार मन ही मन भली भाँति निश्‍चय कर कि, यही सौता है श्रोर श्रपना प्रयोजन सिद्ध हुश्रा देख, उसी वृक्ष पर झच्छी तरह बेठ गए

1.sa: ततः कुमुदषण्डाभो निर्मलम् निर्मलोदयः ।प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम् ।। ५-१७- १।।
1.en: Then the Moon shining like a bed of lilies rose stainless, ascended the clear sky and looked like a swan swimming through blue water.
1.hi: उस समय कुमुद पुष्पों 'की तरह निर्मल चन्द्रमा निर्मल श्राकाश में, कुछ ऊपर चढ़, वैसे ही शोभित हुश्रा, जैसे नील जल वाली झील में हंस शोमित होता है

2.sa: साचिव्यमिव कुर्वन् स प्रभया निर्मलप्रभः ।चन्द्रमा रश्मभिः शीतैः सिषेवे पवनात्मजम् ।। ५-१७-२।।
2.en: The Moon shed clear lightas if with his brightness and his cool rays he wished to refresh the son of the Windgod.
2.hi: निमंल प्रभा वाले चन्द्रदेव, श्रपनी चाँदनी से हनुमानजी की सहायता करते हुए, उनको भ्रपनी शीतल किरणों से हर्षित करने लगे

3.sa: स ददर्श ततः सीताम् पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् ।शोकभारैरिव न्यस्तां भारैर्नावमिवाम्भसि ।। ५-१७-३।।
3.en: Then he saw Sita whose face shone like the fullmoon. But she was as though sinking under the burden of sorrow, like a boat with heavy load sinking in water.
3.hi: हनुमानजी ने चांदनी के सहारे चन्द्रमुखी सीता को देखा उस समय सीता की दशा मारे शोक के बंसी ही हो रही थी; जैसी कि, श्रधिक बोझ से लदी हुई नाव की जल में होती है

4.sa: दिदृक्षमाणो वैदेहीम् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।स ददर्शाविदूरस्था राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः ।। ५-१७-४।।
4.en: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.
4.hi: जानकी को देखते-देखते पवननन्दन हनुमानजी की दृष्टि उन भयङ्कर रूपों वाली राक्षसियों पर पड़ी जो सीताजी के समीप ही बैठी हुई थीं

5.sa: एकाक्षीमेककर्णाम् च कर्णप्रावरणाम् तथा ।अकर्णाम् शङ्कुकर्णाम् च मस्तकोच्छ्वासनासिकाम् ।। ५-१७-५।।
5.en: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.

6.sa: अतिकायोत्तमाङ्गीं च तनुदीर्घशिरोधराम् ।ध्वस्तकेशीम् तथाकेशीम् केशकम्बलधारिणीम् ।। ५-१७-६।।
6.en: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.
6.hi: कोई टेढे-मेढ़े प्रङ्गों वालो, कोई पीली, कोई काली, कोई सदा क्रुद्ध रहने वाली और कोई कलहप्रिया थी । उनमें कोई लोहे का बड़ा शूल ग्रौर ~ कोई काँटेदार मुद्गर हाथ में लिये हुए थी

7.sa: लम्बकर्णललाटाम् च लम्बोदरपयोधराम् ।लम्बोष्ठीं चुबुकोष्ठीं च लम्बास्याम् लम्बजानुकाम् ।। ५-१७-७।।
7.en: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.
7.hi: किसी के लम्बे-लम्बे कान श्रौर लम्बा कपाल था श्रौर किसी का लम्बा पेट और लम्बे पयोधर (स्तन) थे, किसी के लम्बे श्रोंठ, किसी के श्रोंठ ठुड्डी तक लटक रहे थे, कोई लम्बे मुख वाली थी प्रौर कोई लम्बी जाँघों वाली थी

8.sa: ह्रस्वाम् दीर्घाम् च कुब्जाम् विकटाम् वामनां तथा ।करालाम् भुग्नवक्त्राम् च पिङ्गाक्षीम् विकृताननाम् ।। ५-१७-८।।
8.en: While Hanuman was eager to observe Sita he saw many shedemons in ugly appearance close by her. One of them was oneeyed, another with a single ear, a third had ears covering the body, yet another had pointed (spikelike) ears, one was breathing through the nose on the head, one had long thin neck, one was hairless another had hair covering like a blanket. One of them had hanging ears on the forehead, another had big hanging lips, still another had long lips hanging up to the chin. So also one had protruding knees, one stunted, one tall, another had lips extending up to her chin, yet another was longfaced and another had long knees. There was one pigmy, one tall, one was humpbacked and another a dwarf.Similarly an ugly looking one, another with gaping mouth, still another with a distorted face, one with yellow eyes and one of deformed face were seen.

9.sa: विकृताः पिङ्गलाः कालीः क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः ।कालायसमहाशूलकूटमुद्गधारिणीः ।। ५-१७-९।।
9.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.

10.sa: वराहमृगशार्दूलमहिषाजशिवामुखीः ।गजोष्ट्र हयपादीश्च निखातशिरसोपराः ।। ५-१७-१०।।
10.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
10.hi: किसी का मुख शूकर जैसा, किसी का हिरन जेसा, किसी का शादूल जसा, किसी का भैंसा जैसा,' किसी का बकरी. जंसा और किसी का स्यारिन जैसा था । किसी के पैर हाथी जसे, किसी के ऊंट जसे श्रौर किसी के घोड़े जैसे थे । किसी-किसी का सिर माथे में घुसा हुआ था

11.sa: एकहस्तैकपादाश्च खरकर्ण्यश्वकर्णिकाः ।गोकर्णीर्हस्तिकर्णीईश्च हरिकर्णीस्तथापराः ।। ५-१७-११।।
11.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
11.hi: कोई एक हाथ ग्रोर कोई एक पैर वालो थो ! किसी के कान गधे जैसे, किसी के घोड़े जसे, किमो के गाय जैसे, कितो के हाथी जैसे तथा किसी के बन्दर जैसे थे

12.sa: अतिनासाश्च तिर्यङ्नासा अनासिकाः ।गजनन्निभनासाश्च ललाटोच्च्वासनासिकाः ।। ५-१७-१२।।
12.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
12.hi: कितो के नाक थी ही नहीं, हिरो के नाक तो थो, किन्तु वह बहुत बड़ी थी । किती को नाक टेढो थो म्रौर किरी को नासिका की बनावट विशेष तरह की थो । किनी को नाक हाथी को मूड जेसी ग्रौर किसी कौ नाक ललाट में थी जिससे वह सांस लेती थी

13.sa: हस्तिपादा महापादा गोपादाः पादचूळिकाः ।अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवा अतिमात्रकुचोदरीः ।। ५-१७-१३।।
13.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
13.hi: किपो के हाथी जेसे पेर, किसी के महाभारी पेर, किसी के बैलों जैसे पेर और किपो के पेरों पर चोटो जैसे केशों का समूह था । किक्षी की केवल गर्दन और सिर और कितो के केवल पेट और स्तन ही स्तन देख पड़ते थे

14.sa: अतिमात्रस्यनेत्राश्च दीर्घजिह्वानखास्तथा ।अजामुखीर्हस्तिमुखीर्गोमुखाः सूकरीमुखीः ।। ५-१७-१४।।
14.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
14.hi: किसी के बड़ा मुख प्रौर किसी के बड़े-बड़े नेत्र थे और किसी के लम्बी जीभ प्रौर नख थे । कोई बकरे के मुख वाली, कोई हायी के मुख वालो, कोई गौ के मुख वाजो प्रौर कोई शूकरी जैसे मुश्चवालो यी

15.sa: हयोष्ट्रखरवक्त्राश्च राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः ।शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च क्रोधनाः कलहप्रियाः ।। ५-१७-१५।।
15.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
15.hi: फिसी का मुल घोडे जैसा, किसी का ऊंट जैसा आर किसी का गधे जैसा था । वे सब राक्षसी भयद्भुर रूपवाली थीं । उनके हाथों में शूल और मुद्गर थे तथा वे बड़ी गुस्सेल भौर झगड़ा करने वाली थीं

16.sa: कराळा धूम्रकेशीश्च राक्षसीर्विकृताननाः ।पिबन्तीः सततं पानं सदा मां ससुराप्रियाः ।। ५-१७-१६।।
16.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
16.hi: वे भयङ्कर औरौर धुएं के तुल्य केशवाली तथा भयङ्कर मुखों वाली राक्षसियाँ थीं । वे सदा शराब पिया करती थीं क्योंकि उनको शराब पीना श्रौर मांस खाना बहुत प्रिय लगता था

17.sa: मांसशोणितदिग्धाङ्गीर्मांसशोणितभोजनाः ।ता ददर्श कपिश्रेष्ठो रोमहर्षणदर्शनाः ।। ५-१७-१७।।
17.en: Hanuman, the leader of the monkeys saw there shedemons of several distorted forms. Some were brown in colour and some black and some quarrelsome some holding spears, mallets and hammers of black iron, some with faces like boars, deer, tigers, goats and jackals feet like those of elephants, camels and horses, some had their head sunk into the trunk, others having one hand or one leg likewise some having ears like that of a donkey or a horse or a cow some with elephant ears and some with monkey ears some with big nose, without nose,with crooked nose and some without nostrils breathing through their forehead and some with the trunk of an elephant. Some with elephantfeet, with huge feet, and feet like that of cows and some with hair on their feet. There were some with huge heads and necks, some having large breasts, bellies, some with hanging breasts, and some with long nails and tongues. Similarly there were some having faces of goats, mouths of horses, camels or donkeys. They were terrifying, armed with iron crowbars and tridents. Some were wrathful, some with uneven gaping mouth, and some with smoky hair and distorted faces. They were always found drinking, smeared with flesh and blood and feeding on flesh and blood. Their appearance was horripilating. All of them were seated around the trunk of massive tree.
17.hi: उनके शरीर में मांस और रुविर सना हुआ था, क्योंकि वे रुचिर पीतीं श्रौर मांस खाया करती थीं । उनको देखने से देखने वाले के शरीर के रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते थे। एसी राक्षसियों को हनुमानजी ने वहाँ देखा

18.sa: स्कन्धवन्तमुपासीनाः परिवार्य वनस्पतिम् ।तस्याधस्ताच्च ताम् देवीम् राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम् ।। ५-१७-१८।।
18.en: The illustrious Hanuman watched the blameless princess Janaki who was seated under that tree.
18.hi: वे सब की सब, उस सघन वृक्ष को घेरे हुए थीं 'जिसके नीचे सुन्दरी राजपुत्री सीताजी बेठी हुई थीं

19.sa: लक्षयामास लक्ष्मीवान् हनुमान् जन्कात्मजाम् ।निष्प्रभाम् षोकसन्तप्ताम् मलसम्कुलमूर्धजाम् ।। ५-१७-१९।।
19.en: Shorn of lustre, unkempt hair filled with dust, she appeared like a meteor slipped and fallen on land, merits exhausted.

20.sa: क्षीणपुण्याम् च्युताम् भूमौ ताराम् निपतितामिव ।चारित्रव्यपदेशाड्यां भर्तृदर्शनदुर्गताम् ।। ५-१७-२०।।
20.en: She was rich by her reputation for chastity but poor as she yearned to see her husband. Though devoid of all excellent ornaments, she looked adorned with love for her husband.
20.hi: चारित्रव्यपदेशाढयां-पतिब्रताघर्माचरणख्यातिसम्पन्नाम । (गो० ) मानो क्षीणपुण्य कोई तारा पृथिवी पर गिरा पड़ा है । सीताञ्जी एक प्रलिद्ध पतिव्रता स्त्री हे परन्तु इस समय इनको अपने पति का दर्शन दुलंभ ही रहा है

21.sa: भूषणैरुत्तमोर्हीनाम् भर्तृवात्सल्यभूषणाम् ।राक्षसाधिपसम्रुद्धाम् बन्धुभिश्च विना कृताम् ।। ५-१७-२१।।
21.en: Besieged by the demon king, deprived of her near and dear ones, Sita was looking like a fettered female elephant separated from its herd and besieged by lions.
21.hi: यद्यपि उनके अगों में बढ़िया गहने नहीं हे; तथापि वे पतिप्रेम रूपी भूषण से भूषित हैं और बन्धुजनों से रहित, वे रावण के यहाँ नजरबन्द हैं

22.sa: वियूथाम् सिम्हसम्रुद्धाम् बद्धाम् गजवधूमिव ।चन्द्ररेखाम् पयोदान्ते शारदाब्रैरिवावृताम् ।। ५-१७-२२।।
22.en: She appeared like a streak (crescent) of Moon covered by autumnal clouds at the close of the rainy season. She looked haggard since she was out of contact with her husband an unused lute with its strings let loose.
22.hi: उस समय जानकोजी एसी जान पड़ती थीं, मानो अपने झड से छुटी झौर बंधी हुई कोई हथिनी, सिंह के चंगुल में फंस गई हो । अथवा वर्षाऋतु के अन्त में मानो चन्द्र की चाँदनी शारदीय मेघों में छिप रही हो

23.sa: क्लिष्टरूपामसंस्पर्शादयुक्तामिव वल्लकीम् ।स ताम् भर्तवशे युक्तामयुक्ताम् राक्षसीवशे ।। ५-१७-२३।।
23.en: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.
23.hi: उबटनादि न लगाने से, वे मानो बहुत दिनों से बिना बजाई बीणा की तरह मलिन हो रही हैँ । जो सीताजी अपने पति के पास रहने योग्य हैं वे आज राक्षसियों के कूरव टाक्ष की लक्ष्य बनी हुई हूँ भ्रथवा राक्षसियों के पहरे में हें

24.sa: अशोकवनिकामध्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम् ।ताभिः परिवृताम् तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम् ।। ५-१७-२४।।
24.en: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.
24.hi: प्रशोकवाटिका में सीता, मानो शोकसागर में डबती और उतराती ह अथवा मङ्गल ग्रह से ग्रसित रोहिणी की तरह, उन राक्षसियों से घिरी हुई हैं

25.sa: ददर्श हनुमान् देवीम् लतामकुसुमामिव ।सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गीवपुषा चाप्यलंकृता ।। ५-१७-२५।।
25.en: Even though she was daubed with dirt, and had no ornaments on her, she looked bright like a lotus fibre smeared with mud.

26.sa: मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति च न भाति च ।मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम् ।। ५-१७-२६।।
26.en: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.
26.hi: सुन्दर होने पर भो सीताजी कीचड़ में सनी हुई नलिनी की तरह शोभाहीन हो रही थीं । हनुमानज़ी ने देखा कि, मृगनयनी सीताजी अपने शरीर को एक जीण और मेले-कुचैले बस्त्र से ढेंके हुए हैं। यद्यपि सीताजी इस समय उदास थीं तथापि वे श्रोरामचन्द्र जी के बल पराक्रम का स्मरण कर, उदास नहीं जान पड़ती थीं

27.sa: संवृताम् मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः ।ताम् देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा ।। ५-१७-२७।।
27.en: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.

28.sa: रक्षिताम् स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम् ।ताम् दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् सीताम् मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम् ।मृगकन्यामिव त्रस्ताम् वीक्षमाणाम् समन्ततः ।। ५-१७-२८।।
28.en: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.
28.hi: काले-काले नेत्रों वाली सीता जी अपने शील स्वभाव से स्वयं अपने वतिब्रत घर्मं की रक्षा कर रही थीं । उन मुगशावकनय्रनी सीताजी को हनुमानजी ने देखा

29.sa: दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः ।सम्घातमिव शोकानाम् दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोथिताम् ।। ५-१७-२९।।
29.en: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.

30.sa: ताम् क्षमां सुविभक्ताङ्गीं विनाभरणशोभिनीम् ।प्रहर्षमतुलम् लेभे मारुतिः प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम् ।। ५-१७-३०।।
30.en: She was a tolerant lady. She had beautiful limbs which looked splendid even though she was not wearing ornaments. Hanuman experienced immeasurable joy on seeing Mythili.
30.hi: उस समय हनुमानजी को ऐसा जान पड़ा) मानो शोकसागर से दुःख- रूपी लहरें उठ रही हों । क्षमा की साक्षात्‌ मूर्ति, सुन्दर अङ्गो वाली तथा बिना आभूषणो के भी शोभायमान जानकीजी को देख, हनुमानजी बहुत प्रसन्न हुए । श्रेष्ठ नेत्रों वाली जानकीजी को देख, हनुमानजी श्रानन्द के श्राँसु बहाने लगे ग्रौर उन्होंने मनसा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को प्रणाम किया

31.sa: हर्षजानि च सोऽश्रूणि ताम् दृष्ट्वा मदिरेक्षणाम् ।मुमुचे हनुमांस्तत्र नमश्चक्रे च राघवम् ।। ५-१७-३१।।
31.en: Seeing that lady with eyes intoxicating, Hanuman shed tears of joy. At once he paid obeisance to Rama. (thinking he could trace Sita at last).

32.sa: नमस्कृत्वा रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् ।सीतादर्शनसम्हृष्टो हनुमान् सम्वृतोऽभवत् ।। ५-१७-३२
32.en: Heroic Hanuman felt happy when he saw Sita. He offered salutations to Rama and Lakshmana at heart and covered himself (with the leaves of the Simsupa tree) and waited. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: तथा विप्रेक्षमाणस्य वनम् पुष्पितपादपम् ।विचिन्वतश्च वैदेहीम् किंचिच्चेषा निशाभवत् ।। ५-१८-१।।
1.en: The night came to a close while Hanuman went searching and looking for Sita at Ashoka grove full of flowering trees.
1.hi: पुष्पित वृक्षों से युक्त भ्रशोकवाटिका को देखते-देखते ग्रौर सीता को खोजते' खोजते अ्रब थोड़ी ही रात शेष रह गई थी

2.sa: षडङ्गवेदविदुषाम् क्रतुप्रवरयाजिनाम् ।शुश्राव ब्रह्मघोषान् स विरात्रे ब्रह्मरक्षसाम् ।। ५-१८-२।।
2.en: At dawn sounds of recitation of Vedas and the six auxillary sciences, (i.e .grammar, prosody, etymology, phonetics, astronomy and the science of rituals) by the brahmins among demons wellversed in performing exalted sacrificial ceremonies were heard.
2.hi: रात बीतने पर षडङ्गवेदो के ज्ञाता श्रौर उत्तमोत्तम यज्ञों के करने वाले ब्राह्मण राक्षसों के वेदपाठ की घ्वनि, हनुमानजी ने सुनी

3.sa: अथ मङ्गलवादित्रशब्दैः श्रुतिमनोहरैः ।प्रबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः ।। ५-१८-३।।
3.en: By that time the strongarmed, powerful, tennecked Ravana was awakened by the delightful sounds of auspicious musical instruments.
3.hi: नोट--इससे जान पड़ता है कि लंका में चारों वर्ण के राक्षस थे श्रौर यज्ञ करने और पडङ्कवेदाध्ययन करने वाले ब्राह्मण राक्षस भी वहाँ रहा करते थे । “ब्रह्मरक्षसाम्‌” का ्रथं गोविन्दराज जी ने “'्राह्मणत्वविशिष्टरक्षसाम्‌?' किया है । यही भ्रर्थ यूक्तियुवत जान पड़ता है । ब्राह्मण और राक्षस ये दोनों बातें परस्पर विरोध रखने वाली हूँ । हाँ कोई कोई जीव राक्षस योनि में जन्म लेकर भी पूवं जन्म के संस्कारवश ब्राह्मणत्वयुबत हो सकता है । यह भी सम्भव है कि रावण, पुलस्त्य वंशी ऋषि सन्तान था; किन्तु कर्म राक्षसों जसे किया करता था तो भी अपने वंश की मर्यादा की रक्षा के हेतु उसे ब्राह्मणों की भ्रावश्यकता पड़ती थी--ग्रतः राजपौरोहित्य के प्रलोभन में पड़, कतिपय राक्षसों ने ब्राह्मण वृत्ति स्वीकार कर ली हो--श्रतः उनको ही ग्रादि कवि ने “ब्रह्म रक्षसाम्‌” लिखा है । ] ग्रथ मङ्गलवादित्रैः शब्दैः श्रोत्रमनोहरेः । प्राबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः

4.sa: विबुध्य तु यथाकालम् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ।स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरो वैदेहीमन्वचिन्तयात् ।। ५-१८-४।।
4.en: The chivalrous lord of demons woke up as usual.His raiment and garland were still in disarray and he thought of Vaidehi.
4.hi: यथासमय प्रतापी रावण सो कर उठ बैठा श्रौर सोते में खसकी हुई मालाओं ्रौर वस्त्रों को सम्हालता हुश्रा वह सीता के विषय में सोचने विचारने लगा

5.sa: भृशं नियुक्तस्तस्याम् च मदनेन मदोत्कटः ।न स तं राक्षसः कामं शशाकात्मनि गूहितुम् ।। ५-१८-५।।
5.en: The demon king who was unable to hide his great passion and control his senses was drawn towards Sita, in his state of intoxication.
5.hi: क्योंकि वह रावण भ्रत्यन्त कामासक्त था अतः उसकी सीता में अत्यन्त प्रासक्ति थी । साथ ही वह अपने काम-वेग को रोकने में सर्वथा असमर्थ था

6.sa: स सर्वाभरणैर्युक्तो बिभच्छ्रियमनुत्तमाम् ।तां नगैर्बहुभिर्जुष्टाम् सर्वपुष्पफलोपगैः ।। ५-१८-६।।
6.en: Adorned with all ornaments and glowing with excellent splendour he went through the path filled with trees flourishing with all kinds of flowers and fruits.
6.hi: रावण समस्त भ्राभूषणों को पहिनने के कारण भ्रपूवं शोमा धारण कर, सर्वऋतु में फलने-फूलने वाले वृक्षों से युक्त

7.sa: वृतां पुष्करिणीभिश्च नानापुष्पोपशोभिताम् ।सदामदैश्च विहगैर्विचित्राम् परमाद्भुताम् ।। ५-१८-७।।
7.en: Ponds covered with a variety of beautiful flowers and colourful birds always cheerful looked very wonderful.
7.hi: मानो उस समय वह मनोरथों के सङ्कूल्पर्पी घोड़ों पर सवार हो, प्रसिद्ध राजसिह श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के पास जा रही थी

8.sa: ईहामृगैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टां डृष्टिमनोहरैः ।वीथीः संप्रेक्षमाणश्च मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः ।। ५-१८-८।।
8.en: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.
8.hi: तथा अनेक प्रकार के बनैले जन्तुओं से युक्त, चुए हुए पके फलों से भरे-पूरे और सघन वृक्षों से पूर्ण, उस श्रशोक्रवाटिका में पहुंचा

9.sa: नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम् ।अशोकवनकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम् ।। ५-१८-९।।
9.en: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.

10.sa: अङ्गनाशतमात्रं तु तं व्रजन्तमनुव्रजत् ।महेन्द्रमिव पौलस्त्यम्ं देवगन्धर्वयोषितः ।। ५-१८-१०।।
10.en: Ravana, son of sage Paulasti, was followed by a hundred women, just as Indra is trailed by the females of gods and gandharvas.
10.hi: C00. पारे RE, ७७२ प्रात फेल रस्मीएक्ानकह्योस्या: । उसके पीछे-पीछे संकड़ों स्त्रियां भी वैसे ही चली जाती थीं जैसे देवता और. गन्धवों की स्त्रियां इन्द्र के पीछे चलती हैं

11.sa: दीपिकाः काञ्चनीः काश्चिज्जगृहुस्तत्र योषितः ।वालव्यजनहस्ताश्च तालवृन्तानि चापराः ।। ५-१८-११।।
11.en: Some women carried golden lamps, some held yalk tail fans in their hands while others bore palmleaf fans.
11.hi: किसी-किसी स्त्री के हाय में सुवर्ण के दीपक (प्रर्थात्‌ लालटैन) किसी के हाथ में चेवर श्रौर किसी के हाथ में ताइ के पंखे थे

12.sa: काञ्चनैरपि भृङ्गारैर्जह्रुः सलिलमग्रतः ।मण्डलागान् ब्रुसींश्चापि गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः ।। ५-१८-१२।।
12.en: Some moved ahead of him carrying water in golden pitchers. Others followed him carrying circular couches (to be used as seats).
12.hi: कोई-कोई जल से भरी सुवर्ण को झारी हाथ में लिये हुए आगे चलती थीं ग्रौर कोई गोल प्रासन लिए हुए, पीछे चली जाती थीं

13.sa: काचिद्रत्नमयीं स्थालीं पूर्णां पानस्य ब्राजतम् ।दक्षिणा दक्षिणेनैव तदा जग्राह पाणिना ।। ५-१८-१३।।
13.en: One glorious and compassionate lady carried in her right hand a gemstudded jar filled with wine.
13.hi: कोई-कोई चतुर स्त्री दाहिने हाथ में मदिरा से भरी साफ रत्नजटित सुराही लिये हुए चली जाती थी

14.sa: राजहंसप्रतीकाशं चत्रं पूर्णशशिप्रभम् ।सौवर्णदण्डमपरा गृहीत्वा पृष्ठतो ययौ ।। ५-१८-१४।।
14.en: Another shedemon moved behind him holding an umbrella with a golden handle which was white like a royal swan and bright like the fullmoon.
14.hi: कोई राजहंस को तरह सफेद और पूर्णमासी के चन्द्रमा की तरह गोल श्रौर सोने की डंडी बाला छत्र रावण के ऊपर ताने हुए उसके पीछे जा रही थी

15.sa: निद्रामदपरीताक्ष्यो रावनस्योत्तमाः स्त्रियः ।अनुजग्मुः पतिं वीरम् घनम् विद्युल्लता इव ।। ५-१८-१५।।
15.en: The chief wives of Ravana with eyes dizzy with sleep and drinking followed their heroic husband like streaks of lightning follow a thunder cloud. (Ravana who was dark looked like a cloud and the women with dazzling golden complexion appeared like lightning.)
15.hi: अथवा टूटी हुई पंखड़ियों का कमल, भयभीत पक्षी और 'हाथी की सूड से खलबलाई हुई कमलयुक्त पुष्करिणी

16.sa: व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः ।समागळितकेशान्ताः सस्वेदवदनास्तथा ।। ५-१८-१६।।
16.en: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
16.hi: उत स्त्रियों की कण्ठमालाए भौर बाजूबंद प्रपने-प्रपने स्थानों से कुछ कुछ खसक गए थे भ्रौर उलट-पूलट गए थे । उनमें से घ्रनेक के प्रंगराग छूट गए थे, उनके सिरों के जूड़े खुल गए थे घ्रौर उनके मुखों पर पसीने की बूदें झलक रही थीं

17.sa: घोर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः ।स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमाः सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः ।। ५-१८-१७।।
17.en: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
17.hi: घर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः । स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुसा: सुमाल्याकुलमूर्घेजा: (३१७१ वे सुन्दरी स्त्रियां तशो की और नींद की खुमारी से डगमगाती, पसीने से भींगे फूलों को धारण किए तथा जूड़ों में फूल सजाए हुए थीं

18.sa: प्रयान्तं नैरृतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः ।बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः ।। ५-१८-१८।।
18.en: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
18.hi: इस प्रकार मदमाते नैनों वाली वे सब स्त्रियां, श्रति श्रादर के साथ प्रीर कामपीडित हो, भ्रपने पति के पीछे-पीछे चली जाती थीं

19.sa: स च कामपराधीनः पतिस्तासां महाबलः ।सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ ।। ५-१८-१९।।
19.en: Their husband, powerful Ravana under the control of passion looking dull, absorbed in the thoughts of Sita walked slowly as though counting his steps.

20.sa: ततः काञ्चीनिनादं च नूपुराणाम् च निस्वनम् ।शुश्राव परमस्त्रीणां स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः ।। ५-१८-२०।।
20.en: Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, heard their jingling golden girdles and anklets.
20.hi: पाठान्तरे--“गृहिता मालितां” ! २ ब्रल्पाहारां-तोयमात्राहारा- उपवास, शोक, चिन्ता प्रौर भय के कारण सीता का क्षरीर प्रत्यन्त दुबला-पतला हौ रहा था । यह केवल जलमात्र पी कर शरीर को तपा रही थी, भ्रर्थात्‌ कष्ट दे रही थीं

21.sa: तं चाप्रतिमकर्माणमचिन्त्यबलपौरुषम् ।द्वारदेशमनुप्राप्तं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः ।। ५-१८-२१।।
21.en: Then Hanuman, the Vanara saw Ravana of extraordinary deeds, and of unimaginable strength and valour at the entrance (of Ashoka garden)
21.hi: Vinay Aves Seer A १५७०, हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, वह अनुपम कर्मा, भ्रचिन्त्य एवं प्रसाधारण वल धरोर पुरुषार्थ से युक्त रावण, उस वाटिका के द्वार पर भ्रा पहुँचा: है

22.sa: दीपिकाभिरनेकाभिः समन्तादवभासितम् ।गन्धतैलावसिक्ताभिर्द्रियमाणाभिरग्रतः ।। ५-१८-२२।।
22.en: Hanuman saw him in the glow of lamps wet with fragrant oil carried by many shedemons all over.
22.hi: भागे रागे सुगन्धित तेल से पुर्ण भ्रनेक लालटैनों या मशालों के प्रकाश: में रावण का समस्त शरीर भली भाँति दिखलाई पड़ रहा था

23.sa: कामदर्पमदैर्युक्तं जिह्मताम्रायतेक्षणम् ।समक्षमिव कन्दर्पमपविद्धशरासनम् ।। ५-१८-२३।।
23.en: Hanuman saw him, who was possessed of lust, arrogance and intoxication. He appeared like Cupid setting aside his quiver and arrows with his curved, big, red eyes.
23.hi: उस समय रावण नश में चूर था और काममद से पीडित था । उसके विशाल तिरछौहे नेत्र लाल हो रहे थे। उस समय वह एसा जान पड़ता था मानो साक्षात्‌ कामदेव धनुष को दूर फेक कर, सामने चला भ्राता हो

24.sa: मथितामृतफेनाभमरजोवस्त्रमुत्तमम् ।सलीलमनुकर्षन्तं विमुक्तं सक्तमङ्गदे ।। ५-१८-२४।।
24.en: He was playfully pulling up his upper garment that slipped and stuck to his armlet. This excellent unsoiled robe was looking like the foam of churned nectar.
24.hi: मथे हुए अमृत के झागों की तरह ग्रति उजला तथा भ्रति उत्तम वस्त्र, जो खसक कर उसके बाजूबन्द में श्रटक गया था, उसे साधारणतया खींच करः यथास्थान. उसने रख लिया

25.sa: तं पत्रविटपे लीनः अत्रपुष्पघनावृतह् ।समीपमिव संक्रान्तं निध्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ५-१८-२५।।
25.en: Hanuman seated on a leafy branch (of the simsupa tree) thickly covered with leaves and flowers started scanning the identity of Ravana who was drawing nearer.
25.hi: रावण ज्यों-ज्यों समीप ग्राता जाता था, त्योंत्यों हनुमानजी उस सघन पेड़ के फूल-पत्तों में भ्रपने शरीर को छिपाते जाते थे और छिपे-छिपे ही वह यह भी जानना चाहते थे कि, सामने भ्राता हुश्रा व्यवित कौन है

26.sa: अवेक्षमाणस्तु ततो ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः ।रूपयौवनसंपन्ना रावणस्य वरस्तियः ।। ५-१८-२६।।
26.en: The leader of the monkeys started gazing at the chief wives of Ravana endowed with youth and beauty৷৷
26.hi: परम रूपवती स्त्रियों से घिरे हुए उस महातेजस्वी राक्षस-राज रावण | को, ताराप्रों से घिरे चन्द्रमा की तरह शोभित देख वृक्ष पर बेठे हुए पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने सोचा कि, यह महाबाहु सवण ही है

27.sa: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः ।तस्मृगद्विजसम्घष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम् ।। ५-१८-२७।।
27.en: Surrounded by beauties, the glorious king entered the grove meant for women, reverberating with the sounds of beasts and birds.

28.sa: क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः ।तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः ।। ५-१८-२८।।
28.en: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.
28.hi: उस समय महाबली, उन्मत्त, मूल्यवान गहनों को धारण किए हुए प्लोर अवे से कानों को स्तब्ध किए हुए, विश्रवा के पुत्र राक्षसराज रावण को हनुमानजी ने देखा

29.sa: वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रामाः ।तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः ।। ५-१८-२९।।
29.en: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.

30.sa: रावणोऽयम् महाबाहुरिति संचिन्त्य वानरः ।अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः ।। ५-१८-३०।।
30.en: The brilliant vanara (Hanuman), son of the Windgod recognising the strongarmed Ravana got down a little, saying 'This is truly the strongarmed Ravana.'

31.sa: स तथाप्युग्रतेजाः सन्निर्धूतस्तस्य तेजसा ।पत्रगुह्यान्तरे सक्तो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत् ।। ५-१८-३१।।
31.en: Hanuman, possessed of extraordinary energy, was taken aback at the might of Ravana. He remained hiding covered over with leaves.
31.hi: यद्यपि हनुमानजी स्वयं भी अत्यन्त तेजस्वी थे, तथापि रावण के तेज के सामने वे दब गए और वृक्ष की एक डाली पर, उसके सघन पत्तों में क्षपने को छिपा लिया

32.sa: स तामसितकेशान्तां सुश्रोणीं संहतस्तनीम् ।दिदृक्षुरसितापाङ्गमुपावर्तत रावणः ।। ५-१८-३२
32.en: With the desire to see Sita endowed with black hair, beautiful hips, plump breasts and dark sideglances, Ravana returned (to Ashokavana). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रौद्रस्य रक्षसः ।आर्ता दीनस्वरा दीनं प्रत्युवाच शनैर्वचः ।। ५.१९.१।।।।
1.en: On just seeing Ravana, the lord of demons from a distance, adorned with the best of ornaments the charming, young, blameles princess Vaidehi of beautiful waist trembled like a banana plant shaken by a strong wind.
1.hi: राक्षसियो से घिरी हुई दोनभाव को प्राप्त दुःखिनी प्रौर तपस्विनी सीता को रावण सकेतों श्रौर मधुर वचनों से लुभाने लगा

2.sa: दुःखार्ता रुदती सीता वेपमाना तपस्विनी ।चिन्तयन्ती वरारोहा पतिमेव पतिव्रता ।। ५.१९.२।।।।
2.en: On just seeing Ravana, the lord of demons from a distance, adorned with the best of ornaments the charming, young, blameles princess Vaidehi of beautiful waist trembled like a banana plant shaken by a strong wind.
2.hi: रावण ने कहा--हे सुन्दरी ! तू मुझे देख कर अपने उदर ग्रौर स्तनों को ढेक कर, भयभीत हो, अपने सारे शरीर को छिपाना चाहती है

3.sa: तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच शुचिस्मिता ।निवर्तय मनो मत्तः स्वजने क्रियतां मनः ।। ५.१९.३।।।।
