36.en: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.

37.sa: हनुमांश्च महाबाहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः ।नियतामक्षतां देवीं राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ५.६४.३७ ।।।।
37.en: Then the strongarmed Hanuman with his head bowed down offered salutations and reported, 'Divine lady Sita with her constant devotion to Sri Rama is sound in body'.

38.sa: निश्चितार्थस्ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवः पवनात्मजे ।लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३८ ।।।।
38.en: On hearing the nectarlike words from Hanuman that Sita was found, Rama and Lakshmana were delighted.

39.sa: प्रीत्या च रममाणो ऽथ राघवः परवीरहा ।बहुमानेन महता हनुमन्तमवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३९ ।।
39.en: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.

1.sa: ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम् ।प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ।। ५.६५.१ ।।।।
1.en: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
1.hi: सुन्दरकाण्ड का भ्रइसठवाँ सगं पूरा हुआ । इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्णे चतुविंशतिसाहत्निकायां संहितायाम्‌ ॥ सुन्दरकाण्डः समासतः ॥ नल हिल ॥ श्री: ॥ श्रीमद्रामायणपारायणसमापनक्रमः श्रीवेष्णवसम्प्रदायः pA एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु वः। प्रव्याहरत विस्रब्धं बलं विष्णोः प्रवर्धताम्‌

2.sa: युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च ।प्रवृत्तिमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः ।। ५.६५.२ ।।।।
2.en: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.

3.sa: रावणान्तःपुरे रोधं राक्षसीभिश्च तर्जनम् ।रामे समनुरागं च यश्चायं समयः कृतः ।एतदाख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो रामसन्निधौ ।। ५.६५.३ ।।।।
3.en: The monkeys in Rama's presence narrated all about Sita's detention in Ravana's Ashoka garden, the ogresses threatening her and the time limit fixed by Ravana (for her survival).

4.sa: वैदेहीमक्षतां श्रुत्वा रामस्तूत्तरमब्रवीत् ।। ५.६५.४ ।।।।
4.en: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.

5.sa: क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते ।एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः ।। ५.६५.५ ।।।।
5.en: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.

6.sa: रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्वा हरयो रामसन्निधौ ।चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम् ।। ५.६५.६ ।।।।
6.en: On hearing the words from Rama, the vanaras requested Hanuman who was aware of Sita's position to tell Rama all about her.

7.sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै तां दिशं प्रति ।उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा ।। ५.६५.७ ।।।।
7.en: The son of the Wind god, Hanuman who was wise in speech heard the words of Rama, offered salutations to Sita in the direction in which she was located and narrated the story about her discovery.

8.sa: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा ऽहं शतयोजनमायतम् ।अगच्छं जानकीं सीतां मार्गमाणो दिदृक्षया ।। ५.६५.८ ।।।।
8.en: "Having crossed the sea consisting of a hundred yojanas in quest of Vaidehi, I found her.

9.sa: तत्र लङ्केति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे ।। ५.६५.९ ।।।।।।
9.en: "On the southern shore of the ocean is situated the city of Lanka , ruled by the evilminded Ravana.

10.sa: तत्र दृष्टा मया सीता रावणान्तःपुरे सती ।संन्यस्य त्वयि जीवन्ती रामा राम मनोरथम् ।। ५.६५.१० ।।।।
10.en: "There in the inner palace of Ravana, I saw your lovely wife Sita, with all her hopes pinned on you, giving up all other desires.
10.hi: वेदवेद्ये परे पंसि जाते दशरथात्मजे। वेदः प्राचेतसादासीर्साक्षाद्र।सायणात्मना

11.sa: दृष्टा मे राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदावने ।। ५.६५.११ ।।।।
11.en: "I found her in the beautiful garden guarded by hideous ogresses threatening her again and again৷৷

12.en: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

13.sa: रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता ।एकवेणीधरा दीना त्वयि चिन्तापरायणा ।। ५.६५.१३ ।।।।
13.en: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

14.sa: अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे ।रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया ।देवी कथंचित् काकुत्स्थ त्वन्मना मार्गिता मया ।। ५.६५.१४ ।।।।
14.en: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic, and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

15.sa: इक्ष्वकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयता ऽनघ ।सा मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता ।। ५.६५.१५ ।।।।
15.en: "O sinless one O tiger among men To inspire confidence in her I praised the glory of your Ikshvaku dynasty.

16.sa: ततः सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता ।रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ।। ५.६५.१६ ।।।।
16.en: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.
16.hi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथाव्सजे । वेदः प्राचेतसादासोत्साचाद्रामायणात्मना

17.sa: नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्यास्तथा त्वयि ।। ५.६५.१७ ।।।।
17.en: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.
17.hi: वेदवेद्य परे पु सि जाते दशरथात्मजे । वेदः प्राचतसादासीत्साज्षाद्रासायणात्मना

18.sa: एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी ।उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ ।। ५.६५.१८ ।।।।
18.en: "O bull among men I saw Janaki,the delight of Janaka, a formidable lady filled with devotion to you and richly endowed with austerity.

19.sa: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथा वृत्तं तवान्तिके ।चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव ।। ५.६५.१९ ।।।।
19.en: "O wise one, with your ring given her, she told me an anecdote of a crow that took place at Chitrakuta.

20.sa: विज्ञाप्यश्च नरव्याघ्रो रामो वायुसुत त्वया ।अखिलेनेह यद् दृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी ।। ५.६५.२० ।।।।
20.en: (She said)'O son of the Windgod you should let Rama, the tiger among men know all that you have seen here.

21.sa: अयं चास्मै प्रदातव्यो यत्नात् सुपरिरक्षितः ।ब्रुवता वचनान्येवं सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः ।। ५.६५.२१ ।।।।
21.en: 'Within hearing of Sugriva, tell him about your efforts. Present this(signet) to Rama carefully preserved by me.

22.sa: एष चूडामणिः श्रीमान् मया सुपरिरक्षितः ।मनःशिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः ।। ५.६५.२२ ।।।।
22.en: 'This auspicious (jewel) Chudamani has been preserved by me very carefully. Remind him of the decorative red mark he painted with a stone pigment on my forehead, indeed, it is proper to remind him of this.

23.sa: त्वया प्रनष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि ।एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान् मया ते वारिसम्भवः ।। ५.६५.२३ ।।।।
23.en: 'O sinless one tell Rama that this auspicious Chudamani born in the ocean is sent to him and I was gazing at it as if it was him (Rama) and feeling happy.

24.sa: एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रमोदिष्ये व्यसने त्वामिवानघ ।जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ।ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवयं रक्षसां वशमागता ।। ५.६५.२४ ।।।।
24.en: 'O Son of Dasaratha I will hold on to life for a month. Captured by the demons, I will not live for more than a month'.

25.sa: इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्मचारिणी ।रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना ।। ५.६५.२५ ।।।।
25.en: "With her limbs emaciated through austerities detained in Ravana's inner palace, eyes wide open in fear, Sita said this to me:

26.sa: एतदेव मया ऽ ऽख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा ।सर्वथा सागरजले सन्तारः प्रविधीयताम् ।। ५.६५.२६ ।।।।
26.en: "O Rama I have spoken everything that has happened. We have to pay attention to the means of crossing the ocean."

27.sa: तौ जाताश्वासौ राजपुत्रौ विदित्वा तच्चाभिज्ञानं राघवाय प्रदाय ।देव्या चाख्यातं सर्वमेवानुपूर्व्याद्वाचा सम्पूर्णं वायुपुत्रः शशंस ।। ५.६५.२७ ।।
27.en: Coming to know that the two princes were sighing in relief, Hanuman presented the token of identification given by Sita to Rama, after having communicated in full the messsage of Sita in an orderly manner. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

1.sa: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मजः ।तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः ।। ५.६६.१ ।।।।
1.en: Thus addressed by Hanuman, Rama held the token (Chudamani) against his bosom and wept with Lakshmana.
1.hi: हनुमान्‌ जी द्वारा यथावत्‌ कहे हुए वचन सुन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए ओर प्रिय सवाद सुनने क अनन्तर सप्रयोचित यह वचन बोले

2.sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघवः शोककर्शितः ।नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ५.६६.२ ।।।।
2.en: Seeing the precious jewel, Rama's eyes were filled with tears. Overwhelmed with grief, he spoke to Sugriva.
2.hi: देखो, हनुमान जी ने ऐसा बड़ा काम किया है, जिसे इस प्रथिवीतल पर तो कोई कर नहीं सकता । करना तो जहाँ तहा, ऐसा काम करने की इस संसार में कोई कल्पना भी नहीं कर सकता

3.sa: यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला ।तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात् ।। ५.६६.३ ।।।।
3.en: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.

4.sa: मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याः श्वशुरेण मे ।वधूकाले यथा बद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते ।। ५.६६.४ ।।।।
4.en: "At the time of marriage, this jewel was presented by my father-in-law. Vaidehi wore it on her forehead and it looked charming.
4.hi: देवता, दानव, यक्ष, गन्धर्व, उरग और राक्षस भी जिस लङ्कापुरी में नहीं पहुँच सकते, रावण द्वारा रकित उसी लङ्कापुरी में

5.sa: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिः सज्जनपूजितः ।यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तः शक्रेण धीमता ।। ५.६६.५ ।।।।
5.en: "This was found in water and was bestowed by Indra out of great joy on Janaka who had performed a grand sacrificial ceremony. So it was worshipped by elders of the family.
5.hi: पहुँच ज्ञाता हुआ यहाँ से कोन लोट क्षकता हे ?

6.sa: इमं दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं यथा तातस्य दर्शनम् ।अद्यास्म्यवगतः सौम्य वैदेहस्य तथा विभोः ।। ५.६६.६ ।।।।
6.en: "O noble Sugriva now when I see this excellent jewel, I get direct sight of my father and king of Videha (in the same way as I obtained the sight of Sita).
6.hi: हनुमान्‌ के समान बलवान ओर पराक्रमी, और ऐसा कोन है, जो अकेला, उस दुर्धध नगरी में, घुस भी सके, जो राक्षसो द्वारा सुरक्षित हे

7.sa: अयं हि शोभते तस्याः प्रियाया मूर्ध्नि मे मणिः ।अस्याद्य दर्शनेनाहं प्राप्तां तामिव चिन्तये ।। ५.६६.७ ।।।।
7.en: "This jewel was shining on the head of my beloved. Now its mere look makes me feel that I am seeing her.
7.hi: निश्‍्चच ही इस प्रकार अपने विक्रम के योग्य वल प्रदर्शन कर, हनुमान्‌ जी ने सुग्रीव का बड़ा भारी श्रत्यकार्य ( चाकरी ) किया है

8.sa: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः ।पिपासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ति वाक्यवारिणा ।। ५.६६.८ ।।।।
8.en: "O handsome Hanuman Sita is like water for a thirsty person. Tell me again and again what Sita said to you. Sprinkle on me (lifegiving) water of her words in the form of message.
8.hi: जो श्रत्य, अपने मालिक द्वारा किसी कठिन काम को करने के लिए नियुक्त किए जाने पर, उस काम को जी लगा कर, € ००५ है डालता है, वह सवो त्तम सेवक कहलाता है

9.sa: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम् ।मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतं विना ।। ५.६६.९ ।।।।
9.en: "O Saumitri I see this jewel born (formed) under water but not her. What can be more sorrowful to me?

10.sa: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति ।क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम् ।। ५.६६.१० ।।।।
10.en: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.

11.sa: नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया ।न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च ।। ५.६६.११ ।।।।
11.en: "Take me to the place you saw my beloved. Knowing where she is I cannot stay here even for a moment.
11.hi: परन्तु हनुमान जी ने राज्याज्ञा में नियुक्त होकर अपना कतव्य कार्य यथावत्‌ पूरा किआ है.। इनको कहीँ भी नीचा नहीं देखना पड़ा । अतः इन्होने सुग्रीव को भी सन्तुष्ट किआ है

12.sa: कथं सा मम सुश्रोणी भीरुभीरुः सती सदा ।भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम् ।। ५.६६.१२ ।।।।
12.en: "She is always very timid. How can my fairhipped beloved remain in the midst of dreadful and fearsome demons?

13.sa: शारदस्तिभिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः ।आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः ।। ५.६६.१३ ।।।।
13.en: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.
13.hi: हनुमान जी के जानकी को दैख आने से में तथा बलवान लक्ष्मण तथा अन्य रघुवंशियों का धम बच गया ( अथवा हम न न >> ज १ धर्मतः परिरक्षिताः--धमेस्यापित्ाः | (गोश ] ३. चाट खाट हुन ज इदं तु मम दीनस्य मनो भूयः प्रकर्षति । यदिहास्य ग्रियाख्यातुने कुमिं सदां प्रियस्‌

14.sa: किमाह सीता हनुंस्तत्त्वतः कथयाद्य मे ।एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा ।। ५.६६.१४ ।।।।
14.en: "O Hanuman Tell me now truly what has been told by her. I am eager to know. Indeed, it will keep me alive just as medicne does. (I shall survive on the strength of her message)
14.hi: जो हो, इस समय, मेरा यह सबस्त्रदान रूप आलिङ्गन ही महात्मा ( महाबली) हनुमान जी के कायं के योग्य पुरस्कार हो

15.sa: मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी ।मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन् कथयस्व मे ।। ५.६६.१५ ।।
15.en: That lovely Sita who speaks sweetly, that fairhipped beautiful one who has been separated from me, my beloved, what did she say? Please narrate. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

16.hi: तदनन्तर रघुबंशियों में श्रेष्ठ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी कुछ देर तक सोच कर कपिराज सुमीव के सामने फिर यह वचन बोले

17.hi: प्रकर्षति--व्याकुलयति, सन्तापयति | [ गोऽ ) a क ष्ट्‌ अझ राग; ष्ट सीता के ढूँढने का काय यद्यपि सब प्रकार से पूरा हो चुका हे. तथापि जब मैं समुद्र को देखता हूँ, तब मेरा मन हतोत्साह द्दो s ९, 9 जाता है

20.hi: यद्यपि सीता का सन्देश मुझे मिल गया+तथापि अब इसके आगे बानरों को समुद्र पार पहुँचाने का क्या उपाय किआ जाय ॥ १६ इत्यक्त्वा शोकसम्भ्रान्तो रामः शत्रु निहंणः । हनुमन्तं महाबाहुस्ततो ध्यानमुपागमसत्‌

1.sa: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना ।सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे ।। ५.६७.१ ।।।।
1.en: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.

2.sa: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ ।पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम् ।। ५.६७.२ ।।।।
2.en: "O bull among men queen Janaki related to me as a token of identification an incident that had taken place at Chitrakuta in the past.

3.sa: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता ।वायसः सहसोत्पत्य विरराद स्तनान्तरे ।। ५.६७.३ ।।।।
3.en: "When she was lying on your lap happily she awoke early and a crow came swiftly and scratched on her breast.

4.sa: पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज ।पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम् ।। ५.६७.४ ।।।।
4.en: "O Bharata's brother, when Sita awoke from sleep you slept on her lap. The same crow again hurt her.

5.sa: पुनः पुनरुपागम्य विरराद भृशं किल ।ततस्त्वं बोधितस्तस्याः शोणितेन समुक्षितः ।। ५.६७.५ ।।।।
5.en: Again and again the crow came to her and scratched her. She woke you up as you were getting wet with blood shed from her body.

6.sa: वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया ।बोधितः किल देव्या त्वं सुखसुप्तः परन्तप ।। ५.६७.६ ।।।।
6.en: "O scorcher of enemies pained by the crow hurting her repeatedly, while you were sleeping happily, she woke you up and informed you about it.

7.sa: तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो दारितां च स्तनान्तरे ।आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः ।। ५.६७.७ ।।।।
7.en: "Seeing the blood flowing from her breasts you became furious like a hissing serpent and said:

8.sa: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम् ।कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ।। ५.६७.८ ।।।।
8.en: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?

9.sa: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः ।नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। ५.६७.९ ।।।।
9.en: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.

10.sa: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः ।धरान्तरचरः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ।। ५.६७.१० ।।।।
10.en: 'That crow, the foremost of the birds was the son of Indra moving about all over the earth swiftly. His speed matched the Windgod's.

11.sa: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः ।वायसे त्वं कृथाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर ।। ५.६७.११ ।।।।
11.en: 'O longarmed, wise and revered Rama, then in anguish you took a cruel decision'.

12.sa: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण ह्ययोजयः ।स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम् ।। ५.६७.१२ ।।।।
12.en: 'You took out a blade of grass from your mat and chanted the mantra to invoke the weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra) and hurled it on the crow. It blazed like the fire of the doom's day.

13.sa: क्षिप्तवांस्त्वं प्रदीप्तं हि दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति ।ततस्तु वायसं दीप्तः स दर्भो ऽनुजगाम ह ।। ५.६७.१३ ।।।।
13.en: 'You hurled the blazing blade of grass on to the crow. That burning blade of grass chased the crow.

14.sa: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः ।त्रिल्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति ।। ५.६७.१४ ।।।।
14.en: 'He was abandoned by his father, even by great sages and gods. Then he went round the three worlds but could not find a saviour.

15.sa: पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वकाशमरिन्दम ।स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ।। ५.६७.१५ ।।।।
15.en: 'O destroyer of enemies the crow came back again to you trembling seeking protection from you and fell on the ground. Even though it deserved to be slayed, you saved him out of compassion.

16.sa: वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया पर्यपालयः ।। ५.६७.१६ ।।।।
16.en: 'O Rama since a divine weapon cannot be withdrawn, it did strike his right eye'.

17.sa: मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव ।भवांस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् ।। ५.६७.१७ ।।।।
17.en: The crow, once released, regained its own abode. "Thus, though you are the best among knowers of missiles, of great being and of good character too —

18.sa: राम त्वां स नमस्कृत्य राज्ञे दशरथाय च ।विसृष्टस्तु तदा काकः प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् ।। ५.६७.१८ ।।।।
18.en: "— for what reason, Raghava, do you not employ the missile against the rakshasas? Neither danavas nor gandharvas, neither asuras nor the hosts of Maruts —

19.sa: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्त्ववाञ्छीलवानपि ।किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ।। ५.६७.१९ ।।।।
19.en: "— are able so to contend with you in battle, Rama. If you the valorous have any concern for me —

20.sa: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।न च सर्वे रणे शक्ता रामं प्रतिसमासितुम् ।। ५.६७.२० ।।।।
20.en: "— let Ravana be slain swiftly in battle with keen shafts; or let Lakshmana, scorcher of foes, receive his brother's command.

21.sa: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः ।क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः ।। ५.६७.२१ ।।।।
21.en: "For what reason does that best of men, Raghava, not protect me? Those two tigers among men, of splendour equal to wind and fire, are able —

22.sa: भ्रातुरादेशमाज्ञाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः ।स किमर्थं नरवरो न मां रक्षति राघवः ।। ५.६७.२२ ।।।।
22.en: "— and unassailable even to the gods: for what reason do they overlook me? Surely some great misdeed of mine alone is the cause —

23.sa: शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ ।सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ।। ५.६७.२३ ।।।।
23.en: "— in that those two scorchers of foes, though able and together, do not protect me." Having heard the piteous and well-spoken word of Vaidehi,

24.sa: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः ।समर्थो सहितौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ ।। ५.६७.२४ ।।।।
24.en: I spoke to her once again: "Lady, I swear to you by truth, Rama is turned away from all but grief for you.

25.sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् ।पुनरप्यहमार्यां तामिदं वचनमब्रुवम् ।। ५.६७.२५ ।।।।
25.en: "And when Rama is overcome with sorrow, Lakshmana burns with it. Your ladyship has been found at last; this is no time for grieving.

26.sa: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे ।रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ।। ५.६७.२६ ।।।।
26.en: "In this very moment, radiant lady, you shall see the end of your sorrows. Those two tigers among men, princes and scorchers of foes,

27.sa: कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् ।इम मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि ।। ५.६७.२७ ।।।।
27.en: "their zeal roused by the sight of you, shall reduce Lanka to ashes; and having slain in battle the terrible Ravana with his kinsmen,

28.sa: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ राजपुत्रावनिन्दितौ ।त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ।। ५.६७.२८ ।।।।
28.en: "Raghava shall assuredly lead you to his own city, fair one. And what token, blameless one, Rama would recognise,

29.sa: हत्वा च समरे रौद्र रावण सहबान्धवम् ।राघवस्त्वां वरारोहे स्वां पुरीं नयते ध्रुवम् ।। ५.६७.२९ ।।।।
29.en: "begetting joy in him, that you should give me." She looked round all the quarters, and from her garment

30.sa: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते ।प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य प्रदातुं त्वमिहार्हसि ।। ५.६७.३० ।।।।
30.en: "loosed the excellent knot of her braid and gave me this gem, O you of great strength. Receiving the gem in both hands for your sake, beloved of the Raghus,

31.sa: सा ऽभिवीक्ष्य दिशः सर्वा वेण्युद्ग्रथनमुत्तमम् ।मुक्त्वा वस्त्राद्ददौ मह्यं मणिमेतं महाबल ।। ५.६७.३१ ।।।।
31.en: "I saluted her with my head and made haste to return. Seeing my zeal made ready for the going, the lady of fair complexion,

32.sa: प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दिव्यं तव हेतो रघूद्वह ।शिरसा तां प्रणम्यार्यामहमागमने त्वरे ।। ५.६७.३२ ।।।।
32.en: "as I swelled in size, addressed me, the daughter of Janaka, her face full of tears, piteous, her speech choked with weeping.

33.sa: गमने च कृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य वरवर्णिनी ।विवर्धमानं च हि मामुवाच जनकात्मजा ।। ५.६७.३३ ।।।।
33.en: "Startled by my springing up and struck by the surge of grief, Sita then said to me: 'You are blessed, great monkey,

34.sa: अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पसन्दिग्धभाषिणी ।ममोत्पतनसम्भ्रान्ता शोकवेगसमाहता ।। ५.६७.३४ ।।।।
34.en: "'in that you shall see the mighty-armed and lotus-eyed Rama, and the mighty-armed and illustrious Lakshmana, my brother-in-law.'

35.sa: हनुमन् सिंहसङ्काशावुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।सुग्रीवं च सहामात्य सर्वान् ब्रूया ह्यनामयम् ।। ५.६७.३५ ।।।।
35.en: "Addressed thus by Sita, I spoke to Maithili: 'Lady, delight of Janaka, mount swiftly upon my back,

36.sa: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः ।असमाद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि ।। ५.६७.३६ ।।।।
36.en: "'that today I may show you your lord Raghava, greatly blessed and dark-eyed one, with Sugriva and with Lakshmana.'

37.sa: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च ।ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतः समीपं शिवश्च ते ऽध्वा ऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर ।। ५.६७.३७ ।।।।
37.en: "Then that lady said to me: 'Great monkey, bull among vanaras, that I should of my own will resort to your back — this is no dharma.

38.sa: एतत्तवार्या नृपराजसिंह सीता वचः प्राह विषादपूर्वम् ।एतच्च बुद्ध्वा गदितं मया त्वं श्रद्धत्स्व सीतां कुशलां समग्राम् ।। ५.६७.३८ ।।
38.en: "'And formerly, hero, I was touched upon the limbs by the rakshasa; what could I do therein, sore pressed by time?

1.sa: अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्तः ससम्भ्रमः ।तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य वै ।। ५.६८.१ ।।।।
1.en: "O tiger among men In view of her regards for me and and her love for you she was confident and once again addressed me:

2.sa: एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया ।यथा मामाप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे ।। ५.६८.२ ।।।।
2.en: 'You may appeal to Rama, the son of Dasaratha in many ways, that he should come quickly and slay Ravana in the battle and get me back.

3.sa: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम ।कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ।। ५.६८.३ ।।।।
3.en: 'O crusher of enemies O brave Hanuman I wish you rest for a while in a secluded place around here and leave tomorrow .

4.sa: मम चाप्यल्पभाग्यायाः सान्निध्यात्तव वीर्यवन् ।अस्य शोकविपाकस्य मुहूर्तं स्याद्विमोक्षणम् ।। ५.६८.४ ।।।।
4.en: 'O valiant (Hanuman) by your presence here, the less fortunate me, will be relieved of sorrow for a while.

5.sa: गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै ।प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः ।। ५.६८.५ ।।।।
5.en: 'O courageous tiger among monkeys when you depart (abruptly) I doubt if I would be alive by your return.

6.sa: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् ।दुःखाद्दुःखपराभूतां दुर्गतां दुःखभागिनीम् ।। ५.६८.६ ।।।।
6.en: I am an unfortunate one, afflicted by sorrow and tormented (by demons). If I am not able to see you I will be lamenting in grief.

7.sa: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः ।सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ।। ५.६८.७ ।।।।
7.en: 'O brave vanaras I have great doubts about your assistants the vanaras and bears, crossing the ocean.

8.sa: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् ।तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ।। ५.६८.८ ।।।।
8.en: 'How will the vanaras and bears cross this great, impassable ocean? How will the princes Rama and Lakshmna be able to cross it?

9.sa: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने ।शक्तिः स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा ।। ५.६८.९ ।।।।
9.en: 'Only three among all beings, Garuda, the Windgod and you have the capacity to cross the ocean.

10.sa: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे ।किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वर ।। ५.६८.१० ।।।।
10.en: 'O heroic Hanuman you know how to succeed. But I wish to know what expedient you have to accomplish which is difficult by all means. O foremost vanara, please tell me .

11.sa: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने ।पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः ।। ५.६८.११ ।।८.१० ।।।।
11.en: 'O Slayer of enemy heroes you have the ability to accomplsh this task singlehanded. By succeeding in accomplishing the objective you will become renowned (and not Rama).

12.sa: बलैः समग्रैर्यदि मां हत्वा रावणमाहवे ।विजयी स्वां पुरीं रामो नयेत्तत् स्याद्यशस्करम् ।। ५.६८.१२ ।।।।
12.en: 'When Rama slays Ravana and his entire army and takes me to his city after becoming victorious it will add glory to him.

13.sa: यथा ऽहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता ।रक्षसा तद्भया देव तथा नार्हति राघवः ।। ५.६८.१३ ।।।।
13.en: 'Tell valiant Rama not to take me back the way Ravana, the demon abducted me out of fear. Which is not right.

14.sa: बलैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः ।मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ।। ५.६८.१४ ।।।।
14.en: 'If Rama, the slayer of the enemy army, could fill Lanka with his arrows and take me that will be a good sight for him to see.

15.sa: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः ।भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय ।। ५.६८.१५ ।।।।
15.en: 'You may make arrangement in such a way that the exalted hero Rama exhibits his might according to his stature'.

16.sa: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम् ।निशम्याहं ततः शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रुवम् ।। ५.६८.१६ ।।।।
16.en: "Hearing the meaningful, courteous and reasonable words of Sita, I replied :

17.sa: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः ।। ५.६८.१७ ।।।।
17.en: 'O queen The lord of the army of bears and vanaras who is the foremost among the monkeys is endowed with enough strength and has resolved to rescue you.

18.sa: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नाः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः ।। ५.६८.१८ ।।।।
18.en: 'Mighty, powerful and tough monkeys who have the speed of thought are under the command of Sugriva.

19.sa: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः ।न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः ।। ५.६८.१९ ।।।।
19.en: 'All of them can go upward in the sky, downward into the underworld or obliquely in any direction without obstruction. They are brilliant enough to do any great task without any difficulty.

20.sa: असकृत्तैर्महाभागैर्वानरैर्बलदर्पितैः ।प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः ।। ५.६८.२० ।।।।
20.en: 'O great lady the mighty vanaras of extraordinary strength can fly with the wind and have even circumambulated the earth.

21.sa: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः ।मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ।। ५.६८.२१ ।।।।
21.en: 'There are monkeys who are more powerful than me or equal to me. None are less strong than me or Sugriva.

22.sa: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः ।न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः ।। ५.६८.२२ ।।।।
22.en: 'When I could come here, what to speak of the mightier monkeys?, People do not send the superior ones on errand, but send only the juniors.

23.sa: तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युर्व्यपैतु ते ।एकोत्पातेन वै लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः ।। ५.६८.२३ ।।।।
23.en: 'O noble lady give up your lamentation. Enough of sorrowing. The vanara army will fly and reach this place at one leap and fill it.

24.sa: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ।त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ।। ५.६८.२४ ।।।।
24.en: 'O noble lady the lions among men, Rama and Lakshmana who resemble Sun and Moon will ascend on my back and reach here.

25.sa: अरिघ्नं सिंहसङ्काशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ।लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणीं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम् ।। ५.६८.२५ ।।।।
25.en: 'You will see the lionlike Rama, a slayer of enemies and Lakshmana wielding bow in hand standing at the entrance of Lanka very soon.

26.sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् ।वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ।। ५.६८.२६ ।।।।
26.en: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.

27.sa: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु ।नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामचिराच्छ्रोष्यसि स्वनम् ।। ५.६८.२७ ।।।।
27.en: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.

28.sa: निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिन्दमम् ।अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम् ।। ५.६८.२८ ।।।।
28.en: 'You will soon see Rama, the slayer of enemies crowned as king of Ayodhya with you, having duly completed the term of exile in the forest'.

29.sa: ततो मया वाग्भिरदीनभाषिणा शिवाभिरिष्टाभिरभिप्रसादिता ।जगाम शान्तिं मम मैथिलात्मजा तवापि शोकेन तदा ऽभिपीडिता ।। ५.६८.२९ ।।
29.en: Sita though afflicted heard from me that you were also in excessive grief on account of separation from her and from my soothing, auspicious and welcome words, she derived comfort and remained quiet. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
